content: The Asrār al-Ṣalāt treats the symbolism and esoteric meaning of the prayer act from mystical and lettrist points of view, with attention also to the Shafiʿi and Hanafi legal positions; it is referred to in the R. Suʾl al-Mulūk and is much better represented in Iran than treatises of the same title attributed to Ibn ʿArabī, Ibn Ṭāwūs, Jīlānī or Niʿmat Allāh Valī.
